title: DX: CLAUDE.md 'Running tests' omits required 'pnpm build' — fresh clone fails with misleading 'Failed to resolve entry for package @flash/core/@flash/swf/@flash/player'
description:
QA FINDING (manual sweep 2026-06-18, HEAD 27448d0).

PROBLEM: On a fresh clone, after 'pnpm install', running the documented unit-test commands fails before any test runs:
  pnpm --filter @flash/swf run test -- --run
    => 95/108 test files FAIL with: 'Failed to resolve entry for package "@flash/core". The package may have incorrect main/module/exports specified in its package.json.'
  pnpm --filter @flash/authoring-ui run test -- --run
    => fails resolving @flash/swf, then @flash/player.

ROOT CAUSE: Workspace cross-package imports resolve through each package's package.json 'exports' which point at ./dist/index.js (e.g. packages/core/package.json '.': {import: './dist/index.js'}). dist/ does not exist until the package is built. @flash/swf tests import @flash/core; @flash/authoring-ui tests import @flash/swf AND @flash/player. None of those dist/ dirs exist on a fresh clone, so vite cannot resolve the package entry.

FIX: run 'pnpm --filter ./packages/** build' (the root 'pnpm build' minus the desktop app) BEFORE the test commands. Confirmed: after building all packages, @flash/swf is 108/108 files (1358 tests) and @flash/authoring-ui is 42/42 files (665 tests) green. (The 3 remaining @flash/core failures are the missing fixtures/flash8-empty.fla, tracked by task 1207 — unrelated to build order.)

ACTION: Add a 'pnpm install && pnpm --filter ./packages/** build' prerequisite line to the 'Running tests' section of CLAUDE.md (and/or docs/18). Optionally make the test scripts depend on a build, or point dev-time 'exports' at src so source-mode resolution works without a prior build. This is a documentation/DX issue, not a code defect — but it silently blocks fresh-clone QA and produces a misleading error that looks like a package.json bug.

SECONDARY OBSERVATION (flakiness, lower confidence): during the very first authoring-ui run (before @flash/player was built and with one test file failing to collect), 'reverseFrames.test.ts > declares the Timeline: Reverse Frames label' failed once with 'expected null not to be null'. It passed 3/3 in isolation and 2/2 in subsequent full runs once builds settled. Likely the known module-level-mutable-state cross-file leak warned about in CLAUDE.md (Authoring UI / 'shared mutable state'), surfaced by the partial-collection run. Not reliably reproducible; noted for awareness, not a confirmed standing bug.
